title: Next implementation and promotion gates
summary: Backfill complete v0.9 project-owned source to Alchemy packages via its branch-based, ready-last autobuild protocol, and qualify native regression and exact optional dependency versions. Develop a real durable change-publication adapter only through ConnectSelector/Queue Fabric, with explicit authorization, frozen payload, replay, ack, consumer checkpoints and provenance. Deferred semantics: POSIX TZif footer evaluator, aliases, time authority/uncertainty, business calendars, civil month/year periods and richer intention disambiguation.
invariants: Do not merge submission transport branches directly to main.
Keep approved source and sphere separate from build/runtime state.
Publication and dispatch need explicit authority; impact comparison alone grants neither.

provenance.claim: Verified against locally inspected v0.9 package source.
